en: All characters within a |burst 2| area are knocked back [b]2 SPACES[/b] and must pass a |hull save| or be knocked |prone|.

Throw a Concussion Grenade within |range 5|. All characters within a |blast 2| area must pass a |hull save| or be pushed [b]2 SPACES[/b] away from the center on failure or [b]1 SPACE[/b] on a success.

All characters within a |burst 1| area must pass an |engineering save|. On failture they take |4 heat| and are |jammed| until the end of their next turn. On a success, they take |2 heat| and they are not |jammed|.

Throw a Shock Grenade within |range 5|. All characters within a |blast 1| area must pass an |engineering save|. On failture they take |2 heat| and are |impaired| until the end of their next turn. On a success, they are not |impaired|.
Two allied mech characters in |line of sight| and |sensors| gain |3 overshield|.
The GMS Micro-Maintenance Suite activates spare motile ablative and fabrication modules commonly found in combat vehicles to proactive protect key components.
Make a |tech attack| against a hostile character within |sensors| and |line of sight|. On a success, the target takes |4 heat| and is |impaired| and |immobilized| until the end of their next turn
GMS wartime electronic assault packages typically focus on exploiting predicted and cataloged back doors common in mech systems.

The Denali is a popular Everest variant built to sustain its allied units in the field without sacrificing frontline capability. It features a powerful ATTACHE-class C/C for coordinating the onboard field-repair drones and extinguishers, enabling the Denali to react in real-time to mitigate or prevent cascading structural damage to allied units. Should this prove inadequate, the ATTACHE C/C is capable of forming temporary networks with allied systems to directly assist with systems coordination, intrusion protection, targeting, and interdiction, without impacting the Denali's own performance.
When you |Stabilize=gear.ms_stabilize| the Denali, adjacent allied characters may clear all |burn|, clear one [b]condition[/b], or [b]reload[/b] all weapons

When the Denali performs a |barrage| or uses a |full action| |tech attack|, adjacent allied characters may |Stabilize=gear.ms_stabilize| as a |reaction|, even if they would not normally be able to take reactions.

Choose an adjacent allied character. They gain 1 of the following benefits until the end of their next turn as long as they remain within |sensors| and |line of sight|:
-They ignore |invisibility| and |hidden| and gain |+1 accuracy| on their next attack.
-Whenever they take damage, they first gain 2 |overshield|.
-They gain |+1 accuracy| on all checks and saves and hostile tech actions have a 50% chance to fail against them, granting them |immunity| to all its effects.
Each effect can only be used 1/scene on each character.

You and all allied mech characters in |sensors| and |line of sight| immediately clear all |burn| and |exposed|, and then |stabilize|. Allied characters affected by this action clear all conditions from outside sources and gain |immunity| to them until the end of their next turn. You may then use |Force Multiplier=gear.cp_auto_logistic_compcon.cp_force_multiplier| on one allied character in |line of sight| and |sensors| or end all ongoing hostile effects on that character.
Choose one effect for this ally. They are not Stabilizing.
